LanguageData.CarryPolicyTip: Configure shared carry lists and assign them to colonists in the Assign tab. Food amounts are in portions, not items: one portion is what an average adult eats in one meal.
LanguageData.NoCarryEntries: Empty. Check items on the right and press "Add selected".
LanguageData.CarryCountDesc:
Portion is not the same as one item.
For food, one portion is what an average adult eats in a single meal (0.9 nutrition, lasts about 13.5 hours). Pawns that get hungry faster (modded races, genes, ...) automatically carry proportionally more items.
For non-food items the amount is a plain item count.
LanguageData.CrossSaveCarryPoliciesDesc:
Configure the default carry policies copied into new saves (the policy marked with * becomes the new save's default). Existing saves are never modified.
Items from currently unloaded mods are kept in grey and will restore automatically once those mods are enabled again.
LanguageData.CrossSaveCarryPoliciesSummaryEmpty: No custom cross-save policies configured yet (new saves will start with one empty default policy).
LanguageData.CrossSaveCarryPolicyTip: Configure default carry lists copied into new saves (existing saves are untouched). Food amounts are in portions: 1 portion = 1 meal for an average adult.
